description: Unified framework for robot learning with multi-physics/renderer support
vibe: Ship focused commits, respect the guide, and never let agent artifacts pollute the repo.
highlights: Single source of truth: the contribution guide owns shared rules; AGENTS.md and skills must not duplicate them.
Strict commit hygiene: feature branches only, atomic commits, imperative capitalized subjects, no AI attribution.
Warp kernel discipline: no kernels in `python -c`, no debug output in production kernels.
Environment consistency: uv-managed env and `uv run python` for all Python scripts.
Skill governance: repository skills live in `skills/` and are validated with a dedicated CLI check.
assessment: This file demonstrates mature engineering taste by refusing to duplicate shared rules and instead delegating to a maintained contribution guide, which prevents documentation drift. Its constraints are concrete and tool-aware (Warp kernels, uv, SPDX headers), showing deep familiarity with the actual failure modes of agent-assisted development. The anti-slop rules around commits, scratch files, and AI attribution keep the repository history clean and reviewable.
